map.行列号从 1 开始；本页深度上限 64 层（递归下降 .. 超出即停止收集）；输: Line and column numbers start at 1; the depth limit on this page is 64 levels (recursive descent .. stops collecting beyond that depth); the input limit on this page is none. Errors on this page are plain text and do not include line/column numbers.
map.表达式必须以 $ 开头，否则抛出「表达式必须以 $ 开头」的错误。去掉开头的 $: The expression must start with $, otherwise throw an error that the expression must start with $. After removing the leading $, split into tokens and descend from the root-only set level by level: a child property token takes that key's value in the current object (skipped when absent); a wildcard token expands array items or object values; a recursive descent token collects all matches by key or wildcard in the current subtree; an index token supports a single index (a negative index becomes length plus the negative value and is taken only when in range), a start-end range with a step (out-of-range skipped, negative indexes normalized before use), and a filter expression (items taken only when evaluation matches); a length token takes the array length or object key count. Each level replaces the whole result set with the next level's results, finally yielding the matches array. When displaying, a single object is shown as that object, multiple items as the whole array, and no results as no match; the match count and query time (end minus start, 2 decimals) are also reported.
